title: Halo was first shown to the world by Steve Jobs, as a Mac game.
caption: Halo was first shown to the world by Steve Jobs, as a Mac game. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #halo #xbox #bungie

instagram.caption:
Halo was first shown to the world by Steve Jobs, as a Mac game.

He introduced it on stage at Macworld 1999. A year later Microsoft bought the studio, Bungie, and took Halo for its new console.

Jobs was reportedly furious. Halo launched with the first Xbox in 2001 and sold the console almost on its own.
